actors.name: Principal of Petersfield Secondary
actors.private_context: The principal is responsible for approving school trips. They are aware of the geography department's proposed coastal field trip and the half-term deadline for sending parental consent letters. They know the deputy head is on leave until late September, which may affect the new risk-assessment signature requirement.

actors.name: Geography Department
actors.private_context: The geography department has proposed a coastal field trip, which has run without incident for four years. This year, there is a new coach operator and a risk-assessment form that needs an extra signature from the deputy head, who is on leave until late September. The department wants the principal's sign-off before the half-term deadline for sending parental consent letters.

shared_context: The coastal field trip has run without incident for four years. This year, there is a new coach operator and a risk-assessment form that now needs an extra signature from the deputy head, who is on leave until late September. The half-term deadline for sending parental consent letters is approaching. The principal's sign-off is required for the trip to proceed.

starting_events.description: The geography department has submitted the proposed coastal field trip for the principal's approval, but the risk-assessment form still needs the deputy head's signature, which is pending due to their leave.

resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the principal actually signed off on the geography department's proposed coastal field trip before the half-term deadline for sending parental consent letters. Otherwise resolve NO at the deadline.
